Live progress reporting for long files, with clearer runtime status and cleanup.

## Highlights

- Shows live inference percentage instead of leaving long recordings at a generic running state.
- Keeps verbose engine output out of the interface while retaining complete `run.log` and `media.log` files.
- Cleans up per-job progress state after completion, cancellation, or launch failure.
- Displays the installed version and build number in the main window.

## Install

Download **Transcriber-1.2.1-macOS-arm64.zip**, unzip it, and move `Transcriber.app` to Applications.

**Requirements:** Apple Silicon and macOS 13.3 or newer.

If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click `Transcriber.app`, choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

[Compare changes from v1.2.0](https://github.com/Pluze/transcriber/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1)
